questions.question: How can I change or replace one of the built-in theme's UI pieces without forking the whole theme?
questions.answerNote: Swizzling: `docusaurus swizzle` either ejects (copies the theme component into src/theme to customise) or wraps it (generates a <Name>Wrapper that renders the original via @theme-original); site src/theme components take precedence over the theme's.

questions.question: What exactly happens when I snapshot the current documentation as a new release version?
questions.answerNote: The docs:version CLI validates the name, refuses duplicates, copies the docs folder (per locale, incl. i18n current.json -> version-X.json) into versioned_docs/version-X, writes a versioned_sidebars/version-X-sidebars.json snapshot, and prepends the version to versions.json.

questions.question: How does the left-hand navigation get built automatically from my folders, and how do I control the order?
questions.answerNote: The autogenerated sidebar generator walks the docs dir tree, creates categories per folder with metadata from _category_.json/yml, links index/README docs to categories, and sorts by sidebar_position / category position (number prefixes are also parsed), then strips position from the output.

questions.question: Why does my production build fail because of a link to a page that doesn't exist, and can I make it only warn?
questions.answerNote: After build, handleBrokenLinks checks collected links/anchors against the route config and reports with logger.report(onBrokenLinks); the config default for onBrokenLinks is 'throw', set it to 'warn' (or 'ignore'). Anchors have their own onBrokenAnchors.

questions.question: How does the blog decide how much of a post to show on the list page?
questions.answerNote: Authors put a <!-- truncate --> (MD) or {/* truncate */} (MDX) marker; the plugin's default truncateMarker regex matches both and the list page loads the post with ?truncated=true so the markdown loader cuts at the marker. Posts without one trigger a warning (onUntruncatedBlogPosts).

questions.question: What runs when someone creates a brand-new site from the starter templates?
questions.answerNote: create-docusaurus init: lists bundled templates (classic, classic-typescript via -typescript variant) or accepts a git repo / local path, copies templates/shared + the chosen template, rewrites package.json, then installs deps with the detected package manager.

questions.question: How is the 'Edit this page' link at the bottom of a doc put together?
questions.answerNote: The docs plugin computes editUrl per doc: an editUrl function option is called with version/path/locale, a string option is joined with the version's (localized) edit base via getEditUrl(relativePath, editUrl) in @docusaurus/utils; front matter custom_edit_url overrides it.

questions.question: Which Node.js version do I need to run it?
questions.answerNote: Installation doc requires Node.js version 24.21 or above (check with node -v).

questions.question: How are translations of the project's own documentation site managed and synced?
questions.answerNote: crowdin-v2.yaml maps website/i18n/en and website/docs + versioned_docs sources to website/i18n/<lang>/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/...; website/docusaurus.config.ts sets i18n.locales (production vs staging lists) and points translate links at crowdin.com/project/docusaurus-v2.

c4Note.note: Package-per-container works well here: 40 containers map one-to-one to @docusaurus/* packages plus website, admin/new.docusaurus.io, argos and a tooling bucket, which is roughly how a maintainer would list them (core, mdx-loader, content plugins, themes, utils, bundler). The layer above is missing: nothing separates core vs content plugins vs themes vs utilities, so 42 containers sit flat. The system is named 'root' (from the root package.json name) instead of Docusaurus, and the ~1,300 Markdown/MDX docs files that make up most of the repo are invisible. Inside big containers (theme-classic 219, core 122, website 92) components are one per file.
expectedContainers: website (docusaurus.io docs site: docs/, versioned_docs/, blog/, src/)
problems: software system named 'root' (root package.json name) instead of Docusaurus
no grouping between package containers: core, plugins, themes and utils are 40 flat siblings
packages/create-docusaurus/templates/classic-typescript is its own container but the JS 'classic' template is not; templates are not deployables
examples/classic-typescript files land in the 'Build & fixture tooling' container (with eslint/knip/vitest configs); examples/classic is absent
website container mixes the real site (src/pages, src/theme, plugins) with 25 _dogfooding test fixtures
website/docs + versioned_docs (~1,300 MD/MDX files) carry most answers but produce no entities
only external system detected is @crowdin/crowdin-api-client; Algolia search is not modelled
